title.narrative: UNEP special agreement Energy for Development

description.narrative:
QZA-0994 Energy for Development - EFU QZA-23/0158 UNEP - Strengthening environmental resilience and governance under the Energy for Development Knowledge Programme - 2024-2029.
The project contributes towards the development of enabling environmental policy, legal and regulatory frameworks and national strategies, and promotes institutional readiness by strengthening national and sub-national institutional capacities to implement such frameworks and strategies. The Project will strengthen the environmental rule of law and human rights-based approaches, including rights to a clean environment, through national reviews and gaps analysis of environmental policy/legal/regulatory frameworks in the context of a renewable energy transition. The partner countries will have differing stages in development pathways, and will require different approaches to achieve a sustainable transition to green renewable energy. In partner countries characterized with energy “poverty” with high fragility and vulnerability, the emphasis will be on addressing the interlinkages between local/community energy needs/environmental degradation/climate and disaster risks, and facilitating development towards net zero emissions and access to clean energy for all. In partner countries which are current or emerging oil and gas producers greater emphasis will be on aligning climate, environmental and energy policies and national targets/commitments, accelerating energy transition and GHG emissions reduction, and strengthening environmental governance capacities to facilitate adoption and investments in renewables.
